_source: SFC Environmental Technologies Limited Red Herring Prospectus dated 19-Oct-2026 (SEBI filing 105380); restated consolidated financials for FY24-FY26 and the three months to 30-Jun-2026 (Rs million converted to Rs crore). Printed page = PDF page. Price band Rs 313-330 and lot 45 from the NSE issue page.

basis.name: SFC Environmental Technologies Limited
basis.brlm: IIFL Capital Services Limited; JM Financial Limited; Nuvama Wealth Management Limited
basis.outside: Price band and lot size from the NSE issue page

cites.pat: p. 412 (attributable to owners; total PAT Rs 144.17 / 152.01 / 160.21 cr)

1.finding: 9,34,11,270 shares of Rs 2 (post 1:5 split and 2:1 bonus of Sep-2024); FY26 EPS Rs 16.52. No pre-IPO placement was made; share count unchanged since the DRHP.

2.finding: Operating cash flow Rs -11.69 / +65.51 / -25.80 cr FY24-26 against owners' PAT Rs 141.61 / 144.06 / 154.36 cr: cumulative CFO 6% of PAT. Trade receivables rose by Rs 173.64 cr in FY26; cash conversion cycle 156 -> 232 -> 242 days (411 days at Jun-26, seasonal). Q1 FY27 CFO -Rs 21.34 cr. The working-capital object (Rs 74.92 cr) is sized for this.

3.finding: Current tax 27.0% of FY26 PBT; income tax paid Rs 60.00 cr in FY26. Profit is taxed in cash.

4.finding: Related-party dealings outside the group are small (Turbomax India purchases Rs 3.28 cr in FY26; Rs 12.25 cr equity investment in Turbomax). CMD pay Rs 4.21 cr in FY26. Interim dividend of Rs 28.02 cr (Rs 3 a share) declared 04-Sep-2026, before the IPO.

5.finding: Amount-based fresh issue (Rs 150 cr): Rs 42.23 cr debt prepayment, Rs 74.92 cr working capital (both in FY27), balance GCP. No capex object, no fixed share count.

7.finding: Goodwill up from Rs 2.81 cr to Rs 30.32 cr after buying 80% of IST-Anlagenbau GmbH (Germany, solar sludge dryers) on 30-Jul-2025 for Rs 32.32 cr, against Rs 4.81 cr of net assets acquired; no impairment so far.

8.finding: Top customer 14.34% and top-10 64.44% of FY26 revenue (79.20% in the seasonal Q1 FY27); top supplier 17.18% of purchases.

9.finding: Ten show-cause notices (Jul-2025 to Sep-2026) from the Goa SPCB and GWMC to subsidiaries HWTPL and VWTPL over effluent and waste-handling at the North and South Goa plants, plus the Aug-2025 FIR; responses filed, all pending. Portugal claim EUR 5.60 m (Rs 59.75 cr, 7.4% of net worth) against SFC Umwelttechnik GmbH pending; two ex-MDs of that subsidiary claim about EUR 0.2-0.3 m in Austria.

R1.finding: G B C A & Associates LLP; no qualifications. Overseas subsidiaries' accounts partly certified by management (FY24-25 per DRHP); confirm audit status in the RHP auditor's report.

R3.finding: Fresh issue Rs 150 cr: monitoring agency required.

R6.finding: IIFL Capital and JM Financial track records in the desk database; Nuvama's FY27 issues listed in the RHP.

rationale.g1: Revenue Rs 657.50 / 697.86 / 803.63 cr FY24-26 (+6.1%, +15.2%); WWT segment Rs 524.44 / 469.21 / 542.76 cr (p. 501). Total order book Rs 1,574.52 cr at Mar-26 (2.0x FY26 revenue) and Rs 1,570.07 cr at Jun-26 (p. 188); Q1 FY27 revenue Rs 133.94 cr vs Rs 67.79 cr (Q1 is seasonally small). Neutral 18% then easing to 10% as the CBG EPC orders execute; Bear 6-8%; Bull 25% then 12%.
rationale.m: Operating EBITDA (issuer KPI) Rs 193.25 / 207.48 / 235.81 cr = 29.39% / 29.73% / 29.34% (p. 188). Neutral 28% as lower-margin CBG EPC work grows; Bear 24%; Bull 30%.
rationale.nwc: Trade working capital (receivables incl. non-current + inventory - payables) 59.7% / 70.5% / 76.5% of revenue FY24-26 (p. 411). Neutral 70%, assuming partial normalisation with the Rs 74.92 cr working-capital object; Bear 80%; Bull 60%.
rationale.capex: No IPO capex. FY26 capex Rs 16.28 cr below D&A Rs 27.85 cr (which includes right-of-use depreciation), so capex is modelled at D&A. Net debt Rs 92.48 cr = Jun-26 net debt Rs 64.45 cr (KPI: borrowings Rs 204.77 cr less cash and bank Rs 140.31 cr; leases excluded as in the KPI) plus the Rs 28.02 cr interim dividend declared 04-Sep-2026, which goes to pre-IPO shareholders; net worth reduced by the same amount.
